svg.title: An adapter moves from a remote registry through disk and CPU pools before it is GPU-resident, and only the GPU tier removes queueing and first-token delay.
svg.desc: Four residency tiers: a remote registry or filesystem holds every catalog adapter, the local /data cache holds downloaded artifacts, an offloaded CPU pool holds rematerialized adapters, and the GPU holds the active working set. The base model, KV cache, batch workspace, and runtime kernels compete with active adapters for the same GPU memory.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
